# Instance nested factory

Authored fixture for a nongeneric public instance provider with an invariant
unary input and an invariant unary nested result carrying its own Object formal.
The frozen harness checks the inherited facade call, null receiver, future
virtual override, original input/receiver snapshots, ignored callback values,
actual result identity, mutable and immutable payloads, partial stores, and exact
failures across direct, compiled caller, reflection and method-handle routes.
Only authored classes execute. SDK mode supplies the provider hierarchy while
all generated source definitions, metadata, Exceptions and helpers are checked.
